$note: DEMO-SYNTHETIC. Every value below is invented for this example; no loan, notary,
recorder office or county calendar named here exists. The compliance-relevant
attributes are real ontology slots (ontologies/duly-mortgage-closing/0.1.0.yaml)
carrying real code values, so the facts minted from them are contract-conformant —
but they are attestations by a closing coordinator, not extractions from documents.
In production the `known` block is what your extractors and fact store already hold
(see starters/ for span-grounded equivalents of exactly these attributes).
title: ESC-7714 — California refinance, in-person notarization, LA County recording

plan.$note: No wall clock anywhere. The planning date is an input; nothing reads today().

known.$note: A refinance secured by the borrower's principal dwelling: rescission applies.
The notarial act is planned as a physical-presence signing.
The prepared security instrument, measured before the closing.
A refinance: no concurrent taxed transfer, so the SB 2 fee is not exempt.

$note: MODELING ASSUMPTION, stated because it is the example's, not the pack's:
all three 12 CFR 1026.23(a)(3)(i) triggers — consummation, delivery of the
notice of the right to rescind, and delivery of all material disclosures —
happen at the signing table, so all three take the candidate signing date.
A closing where a trigger lands on a different day is a different input file,
not a different scheduler: add the attribute to `known` with its own date and
drop it from this list.
DEMO-SYNTHETIC OPERATIONAL PREFERENCES. Nothing here is law, and nothing here
may ever restate law. These are the only constraints the scheduler is allowed
to encode itself: who is available when. If you find yourself wanting to add
'wait three business days after signing' to this block, stop — that is TILA,
it already lives in rulepacks/tila-rescission-us-federal/pack.yaml, and a second
copy of it here is the defect this example exists to prevent.

signing.$note: Mobile notary; already booked through Feb 13; office closed Presidents' Day.

funding.$note: Wire desk: weekdays only. Saturdays are business days under 1026.2(a)(6); the wire desk is not.

recording.$note: County recorder e-recording window; closed Feb 23 for a synthetic system-maintenance day.
